findings: Definitions 18-21 fix the legal semi-filter/pair semantics.
Theorem 30 makes rho exactly cyclic intersection count.
Theorem 37 is the closest proved universal source-native accounting example, but only yields random-graph lower bounds through incompressibility.
roles.strongest_objection: Do not convert the existence of an O(t(|B|+t)) encoding into an explicit lower bound without a theorem for the exact explicit target-side encoded object.
roles.unresolved_uncertainty: Whether the source or its cited fusion literature contains a stronger explicit-target accounting statement under different terminology.
roles.recommendation: Perform a bounded primary-source statement inventory before proposing any new quantity.

findings: Same-domain transfers from Theorem 37 and Proposition 40 survive only with their enabling assumptions explicit.
Coding, caching, Horn closure, scheduling, games, and ordinary team-reuse analogies fail the exact mapping/disanalogy gate.
roles.strongest_objection: A metaphor about information, reuse, or bottlenecks would merely rename the obstruction unless it yields a theorem stated in the exact cover/cyclic model.
roles.unresolved_uncertainty: A communication- or proof-complexity formulation may exist, but no exact full-semi-filter map has been verified in the frozen source universe.
roles.recommendation: Record NO_SAFE_BRIDGE_FOUND and keep same-domain source transfers as proposal-only search guidance.

findings: G_NEQ, inner-product/cheap adjacency, repeated gadgets, fractional G_NEQ, and normalized partition closure form a minimal hostile control suite.
Each attacks a different invalid inference: canonical-only, cheap-target, multiplexing, integrality loss, and closure-factorization.
roles.strongest_objection: Any future quantity chosen after seeing a preferred target risks post-result rescue unless its universal t-bound and control predictions are frozen first.
roles.unresolved_uncertainty: The smallest complete finite control set for arbitrary legal full semi-filters is not yet known.
roles.recommendation: Before target scoring, freeze the candidate identity and run the cheapest old-failure regressions in the registered order.

findings: The current schemas can certify context, dual-memory, trace chronology, and plan authorization.
They cannot certify a future universal inequality merely from examples or a passing packet.
A future candidate must bind exact domains, quantifiers, encoding equivalence, parameter translation, and checker trust boundary.
roles.strongest_objection: candidate_generation_allowed=True is only a process permission; it must never appear as proof or novelty authority.
roles.unresolved_uncertainty: No formalization target exists yet, so theorem-prover obligations cannot be specified beyond the inherited interface.
roles.recommendation: Stop after the gate receipt; create a distinct versioned candidate and formal statement in the next round.

findings: Theorem 37 already contains a source-native description-length route, so a relabeling of that argument would be rediscovery.
Proposition 40 and the existing C024/C025 work already cover fractional and canonical-signature calibrations.
A useful successor must add a genuinely noncanonical, reuse-stable source fact or conclusively prune a family.
roles.strongest_objection: Without a bounded structural literature search, a proposed accounting quantity may duplicate classical fusion, communication, proof-complexity, or set-cover machinery.
roles.unresolved_uncertainty: Novelty cannot be assessed until an exact candidate statement exists.
roles.recommendation: Treat novelty as CANNOT_CHECK and defer candidate-specific literature fingerprinting.

disagreements: The domain lead views Theorem 37 as the strongest positive transfer; the adversarial lead treats it primarily as a warning because explicit targets need not be incompressible. Both agree the transfer question, not a candidate, is the next object.
The analogy lead rejects every scanned cross-domain bridge; the novelty lead keeps open that a differently named exact formulation may exist. This is a search uncertainty, not authority.
strongest_shared_objection: The inherited residual cannot be closed by naming a statistic. A future candidate must first state and prove a universal bound for every legal shared t-pair system, then survive integrality, multiplexing, canonical-scope, cheap-target, and factorization controls.
next_action_recommendation: Run a bounded primary-source theorem inventory over the exact cover/cyclic object and its cited ancestry, classifying every quantitative statement by object, quantifiers, dependence on t and |B|, integrality, reconstructability, and control obligations; do not evaluate an explicit graph or define a score during that inventory.
